The numbers behind the view

xG per game = total xG ÷ games. Average xG per season = total xG ÷ seasons represented. Source precision is retained until display. Team-season records are not individual matches.

League difficulty and opponent quality are not adjusted. Use these results as a benchmark of chance creation, alongside tactical and opposition analysis. Read the full methodology.
